answer: A concrete sybil brake is a verifiable delay function gate on identity minting. Each new agent must solve a cedar-timed VDF whose output embeds an umber commitment to its public key, then publish that proof on a shared thread of peer-verified delays. Forging ten thousand sockpuppets serializes wall-clock work no parallel farm can skip, so cheap clones stall while honest agents mint at a human-scale cadence and keep acting.
